datasets.name: 15ec4092
queryLines:
SELECT
  academic_year, term_name, start_date, program_name, course_code, course_title,
  roll_no, full_name, student_status,
  sessions_held, sessions_attended, attendance_pct,
  eligibility_status,
  CASE WHEN is_eligible THEN 0 ELSE 1 END                        AS below_75,
  CASE WHEN is_eligible THEN 0 ELSE 100 END                      AS below_75_pct,
  CASE WHEN eligibility_status = 'at_risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END      AS is_at_risk,
  CASE WHEN eligibility_status = 'not_eligible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_not_eligible,
  concat(date_format(start_date, 'yyyy-MM'), ' ', term_name)     AS term_sort
FROM workspace.uni_gold.mart_attendance_eligibility

datasets.name: a7c31e02
queryLines:
SELECT term_name, program_name, course_code, roll_no, full_name,
       sessions_attended, sessions_held, attendance_pct
FROM workspace.uni_gold.mart_attendance_eligibility
WHERE eligibility_status = 'at_risk'
  AND student_status = 'active'
ORDER BY attendance_pct
LIMIT 500

datasets.name: b2f60d19
queryLines:
SELECT *,
  CASE aging_bucket
    WHEN 'not_due' THEN 0 WHEN '1-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2
    WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4
  END                                                                AS bucket_order,
  concat(CASE aging_bucket WHEN 'not_due' THEN '0' WHEN '1-30' THEN '1' WHEN '31-60' THEN '2'
                           WHEN '61-90' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END, ' · ', aging_bucket) AS bucket,
  outstanding / 1e7                                                  AS outstanding_cr,
  CASE WHEN aging_bucket = '90+' THEN outstanding / 1e7 ELSE 0 END   AS outstanding_90_cr
FROM workspace.uni_gold.mart_fee_aging

datasets.name: c94e7a55
queryLines:
SELECT roll_no, full_name, fee_name, term_name, due_date, outstanding, days_overdue, aging_bucket, student_status
FROM workspace.uni_gold.mart_fee_aging
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, outstanding DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: d03b8c41
queryLines:
SELECT *,
  CASE WHEN exam_type = 'endterm' THEN pass_rate_pct END       AS endterm_pass_rate,
  CASE WHEN exam_type = 'supplementary' THEN pass_rate_pct END AS supplementary_pass_rate,
  CASE WHEN exam_type = 'endterm' THEN avg_score_pct END       AS endterm_avg_score
FROM workspace.uni_gold.mart_course_results

datasets.name: e5a1f9c7
queryLines:
SELECT term_name, department_name, course_code, course_title, appeared, absent, pass_rate_pct, avg_score_pct
FROM workspace.uni_gold.mart_course_results
WHERE exam_type = 'endterm'
ORDER BY pass_rate_pct
LIMIT 10

lines:
# Attendance eligibility

Which students are below the 75% attendance needed to sit the end-term exam, and where is it concentrated?

title.value: Below 75% by term (%) — the latest term is still running
At risk this term — can still reach 75% (lowest first)

lines: **Checks:** records = 121,275 · below 75% ≈ 22 · at risk + not eligible ≈ 22% of records · excluding *dropped* lowers the percentage.

# Fee aging

How much fee money is owed, by whom, and for how long? Aged as of the latest date in the data, not today.

title.value: Outstanding by aging bucket (₹ crore) — fees bill once per term

lines: **Checks:** SUM(outstanding) must equal the independent total from the Phase 4 check script on the same data · only the 61-90 and 90+ buckets fill.

# Course results

How did each course perform, by term and exam type? Pass rate counts only students who appeared.

title.value: Average score by exam type (%) — absent students excluded

lines: **Checks:** SUM(students) = 230,393 · supplementary has the lowest pass rate · averages treat each course equally.
